messages:
jenna_pm: Quick heads-up — running a final ops scrub for the Marketplace listing + joint announce (Tue 11/09). Need a 1-line status from each owner by EOD. Core asks: press embargo confirmed, microsite final, SI docs up, legal signoff, staging tenant ready, partner logos + SKUs. Checklist below, paste updates here.

jenna_pm: ```
- [ ] Press embargo window confirmed with partners and press_ops
- [ ] Microsite copy + CTA locked and reviewed by brand
- [ ] Landing page QA on staging (links, analytics, redirects)
- [ ] SI onboarding doc + sample manifest uploaded
- [ ] Legal A/V signoff (TOS + data flow)
- [ ] Partner logo assets + verified SKUs
- [ ] Staging tenant provisioned and smoke-tested
- [ ] Release runbook + oncall roster set
```

mike_partners: mike here — partner catalog done, logos + SKUs uploaded to drive (link: https://rwd.co/partner-assets). Still waiting on one partner for final logo (ETA tomorrow). :v:

olga_growth: microsite copy 95% — marketing review ok but waiting on 2 localized strings from legal for EU privacy line. will post final copy by 1600 PT.

sam_platform: staging tenant spun up in us-west-2, basic smoke passed. hitting a permissions flake on SSO for the SI dev account, triaging with dima.

paul_si: SI docs uploaded to GH (repo: rwd/si-onboarding). Included sample manifest, terraform snippets, and troubleshooting notes. Need one config example from infra (cert path).

legal_bot: @jenna_pm quick note — we have provisional signoff on TOS changes, pending explicit DPA acknowledgement from PartnerCorp. partner legal should return by EOD or tomorrow morning. recommend holding embargo if not received.

press_ops: embargo windows: prefer Tue 09:00 PT publish for primary press; partner embargo alignment needed. also need final PR quotes by 1200 PT tomorrow. can someone own quote consolidation?

jenna_pm: @press_ops i'll own quote consolidation. @mike_partners can you chase the last partner legal ack?

mike_partners: on it. pinged partner legal now.

dima_infra: SSO flake root cause: intermittent role mapping failure when provisioning via CI. workaround: manual map for SI dev account; ETA fix in patch queued for tonight (post-2000 PT). will post PR.

sam_platform: good to know — manual map applied, SI smoke now green. please add the mapping step to runbook so oncall knows the manual step during cutover.

frank_design: landing hero and CTA locked. pushing final images to CDN in 30m. confirm file names are exactly as listed in the microsite config (case-sensitive).

jenna_pm: summary status: microsite mostly green, staging tenant ok after manual map, SI docs ready, legal pending last partner DPA, press timeline set but need quotes. ask owners to update this thread once their item moves to done so i can close the checklist. thanks all. :rocket:

mike_partners: partner legal ack received (PartnerCorp) at 1820 PT — forwarding email to @legal_bot. moving logo item to done.

legal_bot: received — DPA acknowledged. marking legal signoff done in tracker.

press_ops: got the PR quotes from partners. consolidating now, will drop final PR draft here by 0900 PT tomorrow.

jenna_pm: awesome — final call: if no new blockers by 0900 PT tomorrow, we approve embargo window and proceed with Tue 09:00 PT publish. otherwise escalate here. :white_check_mark:
